hypotheses.physical_signature: Project a 2-D spin-2 Coulomb failure-strike director field (cos 2*theta_stress, sin 2*theta_stress) outward from fold-visible fault terminations (collinear propagation cone + Pollard-Segall +/-27 deg tensile wing-crack lobes + opposing-tip releasing stepover chords) and take signed spin-2 directional inner products cos 2(theta_obs - theta_stress) in [-1, +1] against three independent label-free physical directors: (1) Lahontan-deconfounded 1 m LiDAR / 10 m 3DEP scarp strike, (2) vector-consistent Laplace vertical gravity curvature hinge strike g_zz = -(d_col B18 + d_row B11) = 0, and (3) analytical Verduzco magnetic tilt zero-crossing strike atan2(B9, B3) = 0. Pair with Jacobsen (1987) shallow-to-150 m upward-continuation magnetic gradient attenuation ln((|grad B14|+eps)/(|grad TMI_up150|+eps)), GeoDAWN K/Th and U/Th hydrothermal alteration enrichment, Bekker-Davis (2020) label-free alluvial-burial exposure propensity calibration, and Minoux lazy-greedy submodular 300 m triangular-kernel expected-TP_w dot allocation.
hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: USGS QFDB and INGENIOUS reconnaissance mapping rely heavily on aerial photography and 30-100 m DEMs, causing systematic recall collapse across Holocene alluvial fan aprons, thin pediments, and playa interiors (low exposure propensity c(x)) where <1.5 m scarps are diffused at 100 m resolution or buried completely. Spin-2 Coulomb strike concordance recovers unmapped splay/relay continuations expressed in 1 m LiDAR micro-scarps, shallow-attenuating magnetic contacts, K/Th adularia-illite alteration, and Laplace g_zz density steps while actively vetoing transverse Pleistocene shorelines and E-W survey leveling seams (cos 2*Delta_theta < 0).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Shallow subvertical Tertiary mafic dike swarms or welded ash-flow tuff cooling joints striking subparallel to regional NNE Basin-and-Range extension beneath thin piedmont veneers, and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan highstand bars (~1,330 m) where shoreline strike locally parallels range-front fault strike.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86F-EWCS (0.1723) used only 100 m training_features.tif planes (zero 1 m LiDAR, zero 10 m 3DEP/chi, zero GeoDAWN K/Th/U or TMI_up150 upward-continuation depth filtering), scalar elastic tip halos with zero spin-2 strike-director alignment, unweighted PU sampling without Bekker-Davis burial propensity, and pointwise disc_thin instead of exact 300 m triangular-kernel submodular expected-TP_w allocation. H86C-KSLB (0.1241) treated Band 6 (tc) as magnetic tilt and lacked Laplace vector gravity, elastic crack mechanics, and spin-2 concordance.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~20 min total CPU across 3 arms on 2 cores, <1.0 GiB RSS via float16 memmap)
hypotheses.external_data_status: VIABLE_NOW (all 5 external USGS CC0 1.0 rasters restored and SHA-256-verified in .cache/external/ via scripts/download_competition_data.sh --with-external)

hypotheses.physical_signature: Compute biharmonic elastic plate bending-moment divergence nabla^2(nabla^2 B15) of Cenozoic basin-floor depth to isolate narrow blind hanging-wall rollover monoclines, intersected with cross-divide fluvial chi-step jumps (step_max_x1000) and normalized channel steepness knickpoints (ksn_max_m0.9) driven by active blind relay tilting.
hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: Blind normal faults terminating 200-600 m beneath unconsolidated fanglomerate fold the overlying fan surface into 0.5-2 km wide monoclines invisible to scarp-based airphoto mapping, yet reorganize ephemeral channel steepness and drainage divide chi equilibrium.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential compaction flexure of Plio-Pleistocene lacustrine clays over buried paleotopographic bedrock ridges, and lithologically controlled knickzones on resistant silicic volcanic ledges.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86H-2 proposed biharmonic nabla^4 B15 paired with sparse GDR 2-m thermal probes (never implemented); H86C-KSLB used raw chi/ksn z-scores without thin-plate basement flexure coupling.

hypotheses.physical_signature: Formulate dimensionless transtension kinematic partitioning W_k = (B7 - |B8|) / (B4 + eps) and its spatial gradient |grad W_k| focused onto analytical Verduzco magnetic tilt zero-crossings atan2(B9, B3) = 0 and declustered microseismic lineaments (B10, B16).
hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: ENE/WNW strike-slip and oblique Walker Lane accommodation faults (e.g. Carson/Olinghouse/Humboldt transfer zones) accommodate horizontal shear with minimal vertical throw, producing muted topographic scarps and systematic catalogue omissions despite sharp basement magnetic truncations.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Long-wavelength GPS kriging transitions between sparse geodetic stations and postseismic viscoelastic relaxation halos from 1915 Pleasant Valley / 1954 Dixie Valley-Fairview Peak ruptures.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Prior lanes used only scalar sums or products of Bands 4, 7, and 8; none formulated the dimensionless shear-vs-dilatation partitioning gradient |grad W_k| to target low-throw strike-slip accommodation zones.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~12 min CPU; coarser spatial specificity due to ~15-25 km GPS station spacing)
